file_impact.reason: NEW leaf module: the .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid> staging convention, StagedEvent stage/promote/discard (atomic dir+CREATE publish under the existing write lock), and the bounded best-effort stale-staging sweep.

_prepare_event delegates staging to the new module and returns a StagedEvent; stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit promote/discard through it. Removes the makedirs-before-first-event window. File is 796/800 LOC so the logic must live in the new module.
AC4 conversion: _write_event_file mkdirs the ticket dir before finalize_event (which can raise on the secret screen) and before lock acquisition; route it through the shared staging helper.
AC4 conversion: BRIDGE_ALERT emission mkdirs a tracker subdirectory then writes the first alert file; same signature, same shared helper.
NEW: AC2 RED reproduction of the debris signature, crash-before-rename temp-path invisibility to fsck, AC3 concurrent-create staging-name isolation, and the dead-owner sweep test.
Document the .tmp-newticket-* staging convention, why fsck ignores it, and the 043f boundary (the sweep touches only the writer's own staging area, never store data).
